content:
The HWPX generation failed because the required severity string 'High (즉시조치)' was missing from the XML sections.
The verifier failed in test_overview_values_and_actions_are_present with an AssertionError. Specifically, the assertion `assert f'{value} ({severity_map[value]})' in combined` failed because 'High (즉시조치)' was not found in the combined content of section0.xml and section1.xml. While 3 tests passed, the generated HWPX document lacks the specific formatted risk rating required by the audit brief.
